Allocation: allocation = pitch / mask-detector distance / sqrt(12), per axis, radians; the spatial gate compares a squared-angle statistic with allocation^2
Truth: the first interaction of the history: earliest site by TimeNs, ties to the lower site index; its crystal f (and its XY for the continuous diagnostic)
Gate: per (geometry, line, rate) cell over the confirmation seeds: every calibration of that line succeeds; per axis the upper one-sided 95% seed-cluster (Student) bound of G = RMS_Anger^2 - RMS_direct^2 <= allocation^2, where on the SAME accepted events (Anger photopeak window and LUT-assigned crystal c) RMS_Anger uses atan((c - f) * pitch / D) and RMS_direct uses atan((d - f) * pitch / D) with d the largest-deposit crystal of the same history (signed, paired; G may be negative); on the line's isolated held-out rows the per-crystal sensitivity ratio_k = (windowed Anger events assigned to crystal k, LUT crystal c = k) / (full-energy histories whose first-interaction crystal f = k), weakest ratio_k >= AcceptanceRatio * median ratio_k (catches a LUT that compresses a crystal and moves its counts to neighbours; the crystal's escape cancels to the extent both sides are full-energy events); the line is numerically bounded in the frozen development result. Rate cells: the same paired statistic; a piled event is scored by its dominant hit, f and d being those of the dominant hit's own history (the direct reference has no pile-up, by intent: the rate cells measure what the physical readout adds); throughput (accepted / inputs) is reported, never gated.
SensitivityNumerator: the numerator also holds the windowed events that are not full-energy (partial deposits inside the photopeak window); their share is reported per cell (AcceptedNotFullEnergyFraction). Development seed 41000001: 0.3 % at 662 keV (Baseline and Sharp) but 14 % (Sharp) to 22 % (Baseline, reduced budget) at 1332 keV, where the escape therefore cancels only partly. The full-energy acceptance (accepted full-energy / full-energy histories by f) is kept as a diagnostic.
FullEnergy: summed deposit within 1 keV (+1e-6 round-off) of the line: the transport drops a photon at <= 1 keV, so a completely absorbed history is short by at most 1 keV; any larger shortfall is a physical loss
Bound: Student upper interval over equal-weight seeds of the per-seed statistic; calibration failures or empty accepted seeds refuse, never drop
Numerical: On the gate statistic G per axis and line (isolated held-out rows), upper 95% seed-cluster values of the absolute differences: calibration histories 2k/8k/32k (D1, D2) with the calibration replicate floor F (|G(2k) - G(2k, independent flood and streams)|); DOI bins 8/16/32 (D1, D2) and photons 100k/400k (D1) with the optics replicate floor F (|G(base) - G(independent optical seed)|); every optics level recalibrated on the recipe calibration flood and measured on the same held-out events. Component bound: D1 + D2 + F when D1 <= F and D2 <= F; otherwise D1 / (1 - r), r = D2 / D1 <= ContractionLimit (D1 = D2 = 0 gives 0; D1 = 0 < D2 refuses). Photons (two levels): D1 + F when D1 <= F, otherwise D1 / (1 - PhotonContractionAssumed). A line is numerically bounded when every level and replicate calibration succeeded in every development seed and photons + DOI + calibration <= NumericalAllocationFraction * allocation^2 on both axes. At the gate threshold (G = allocation^2) an error of 0.1 * allocation^2 is about 5 % of the allocation in RMS terms (sqrt(1.1) - 1 = 0.049).
Budget: a line whose recipe-level (2k) calibration failed in a development seed while every 8k (or 32k) level succeeded is reported as a larger-budget candidate; adopting a larger budget is a new recipe version decided before confirmation, else the refusal stands
Freeze: development never qualifies a cell; FreezeEligible when at least one (geometry, line) is numerically bounded; the frozen result records the bounded lines; a confirmation cell of an unbounded line is refused; a single frozen candidate bypasses selection when the planner judges the margin clear; repair uses fresh REPAIR32 and new pins
Diagnostics: single-crystal subset and the stage-1 / v2 largest-deposit numbers (c against d), continuous first-interaction-XY RMS of both estimators, both biases and displacement matrices; never gating
Method: LatticeGrowth (LUT v2) on the fine heads; Baseline (12 x 12) legacy LUT and legacy solve, byte-identical. No truth marker.
